name: Monster Dex
description: The seen/caught registry for every species in the game, with completion milestones and rewards. Entries have two tiers — 'seen' records silhouette and habitat on first encounter, 'caught' fills in full data — because the gap between seen and caught is the collector's to-do list, and collapsing them removes the genre's most durable motivation. The registry is keyed by species id and is player-scoped and permanent: trades and releases never un-catch an entry. This component owns registration and completion state only: it does not define the species (species data arrives as input), it does not grant the monsters themselves (pets.capture_mechanic and pets.egg_hatchery do that and emit), and it does not hand out rewards directly — milestone events carry the reward payload for economy.currency or inventory systems to fulfill, keeping item and money grants in their owning categories.

inputs.name: speciesCatalog
inputs.description: Species definitions: id, display data, rarity tier, and habitat. The registry iterates this catalog, so completion percentage always means 'of the configured world', never 'of what has shipped so far'.

inputs.name: milestones
inputs.description: Caught-percentage thresholds that grant completion rewards. Percent-based rather than count-based so adding species later does not invalidate earned milestones.

inputs.name: trackSeen
inputs.description: Whether encounters register the seen tier. Disabling it turns the dex into a pure caught-list for harsher collection games.

outputs.name: entries
outputs.description: Species id to entry state (unseen, seen, caught) plus first-seen and first-caught metadata.

outputs.name: completionPercent
outputs.description: Caught entries over catalog size, the headline number for completionist play and milestone checks.
